body: The U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Iowa confirmed the Chapter 11 plan of Highlander Hotel, LLC, Bankruptcy Observer reported in its daily docket brief. The brief says the court docketed an order confirming the plan (Dkt. 132) on Nov. 12, 2026 in Case No. 25-02166, and that it confirmed Grinnell Center's Chapter 11 plan the same day. Bankruptcy Observer's case page lists Judge Lee M. Jackwig on the case.
The case was filed on Dec. 16, 2025, according to Bankruptcy Observer.

The Iowa City Press-Citizen reported in December 2025 that the hotel filed over several million dollars in unpaid loans, and that the company running it was first sued in Johnson County district court in October 2025 by MMG Investments, a New York company, over more than $4.4 million in unpaid loans. The newspaper, citing federal court documents, listed MMG Investments, the Small Business Administration, the Iowa Department of Revenue, Choice Hotels and Johnson County among the creditors.
None of the sources opened describes the terms of the confirmed plan.

timeline.label: MMG Investments sues the company running the hotel in Iowa District Court for Johnson County over more than $4.4 million in unpaid loans, per the Iowa City Press-Citizen
Highlander Hotel, LLC files Chapter 11 in the Southern District of Iowa
Court dockets order confirming the Chapter 11 plan (Dkt. 132)
